name: DeFi, Bridge and Cross-Chain Laundering
description: Decentralised protocols, automated market makers and cross-chain bridges let value move without a central intermediary performing customer checks. Criminals including hackers exploit these to swap, pool and hop assets before reaching a regulated off-ramp. Obligated entities usually observe this only at on- and off-ramps through exposure analysis and behaviour.

sources.text: FATF, Virtual Assets: Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (2020)
FATF, Updated Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers (2021)
US Department of the Treasury, Illicit Finance Risk Assessment of Decentralized Finance (2023)
